div.p: Named after the Isle of Skye, birthplace of some early settlers including the Bethune, Beaton and Murdoch families, this area was renamed Lyndhurst South in 1894 after publicity about a local murder but resumed its earlier name in 1964. Essentially a rural district, Skye's western section is rapidly developing into a residential area with pressure from Carrum Downs, while the northern section is expected to grow with the spread of residential areas along the growth corridor that includes nearby Cranbourne.
